articles.title: Quebec homelessness rising sharply in regions outside Montreal, report finds
articles.summary: New data from the Quebec government indicates a significant increase in homelessness across the Canadian province, with the sharpest rises noted outside the city of Montreal. A survey conducted on April 15, 2025, confirmed this growing social challenge, underscoring the pressing need for comprehensive strategies to address vulnerability and provide support to affected populations within the region.

articles.summary: Memeorandum is an automated news aggregation platform that provides real-time summaries of online discussions among US political commentators. This tool showcases how technology is used to monitor and synthesize political discourse, offering SSB aspirants insight into automated information gathering and its role in tracking national narratives.

articles.title: HAL hands over four ALH Mk III Maritime helicopters to Indian Coast Guard
articles.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has successfully delivered four ALH Mk III Maritime Role helicopters to the Indian Coast Guard in Bengaluru. This significant handover boosts the Coast Guard's operational capabilities for maritime surveillance and security. HAL's on-time delivery underscores India's growing indigenous defence manufacturing prowess and commitment to strengthening national maritime defence infrastructure.

articles.title: Navy scraps Biden-era submarine contract as overhaul costs surge toward $3B
articles.summary: The Navy has cancelled the long-delayed overhaul of the USS Boise submarine after costs neared $3 billion, with War Secretary John Phelan deeming it financially and strategically unviable. This decision underscores critical aspects of defence expenditure, resource allocation, and operational readiness, highlighting the need for stringent cost-benefit analysis in military asset management and strategic planning.

articles.title: Stream It Or Skip It: ‘Malcolm In The Middle: Life’s Still Unfair’ On Hulu, A Sequel To The Crazy 2000s Sitcom Starring Bryan Cranston And Frankie Muniz
